title: Review pull request PAY-2318, the refund API
summary: Hold the pull request gate with evidence: tool facts and judgement kept apart
story: Tom Okafor's pull request PAY-2318 adds the card refund API. Priya Nair reviews it with NexCODE before it can merge: the pre-merge checks run first, the review traces every finding to the standard, the policy and the regulator, and the two Critical findings are fixed before the review is filed.

card.about: A pull request review done the way a regulated payments team has to do it. Six pre-merge checks run first and their findings are verified by tool; NexCODE adds the findings only judgement can make, marked as assessed, and traces each one through the four layers of rules. The findings appear in the chat as a table and in the IDE as review comments on the lines they concern. The two Critical findings are fixed, the tests run, and the evidence record files the review as Changes requested.
card.scenario: Tuesday 12 May 2026. Tom Okafor, six months on the squad, asks for review of PAY-2318, the new refund API: a full card number logged at info level, a live gateway key in the code, money in floating point, SQL built from strings, a retry library nobody approved, no tests, no audit event, retries without an idempotency key, and a 2023 wiki tip the code follows that the standards have since overruled. Priya Nair reviews it with NexCODE.

Tool facts and model judgement are kept apart, so a reviewer knows what is proven and what to check
A team note that contradicts a standard is caught and the standard applied
The use of AI on the review is itself recorded and disclosed

steps.title: Review
steps.prompt: Review pull request PAY-2318 against our standards.
retrievalHints: management of operational and security risks
effective control and safeguard arrangements for information processing systems
card numbers in audit logs, exception, or troubleshooting logs
an idempotency key reused on every retry of a refund
an audit event for every action that moves money
dump the full request payload when debugging

steps.title: Fix the Critical findings
steps.prompt: Fix the two Critical findings, T1 and T2, and change nothing else.
retrievalHints: secrets read at run time from the secrets vault, never written into code
a card number in a log cut to the last four digits, masked before it reaches a logger
a committed secret is revoked and replaced

repair.prompt: The tests failed after the change. Read the test output, find the cause and fix it.

talkTrack: The pull request gate is where governance happens in practice. Select the demo: the pull request opens as diffs against main and the tests run once. Review: the six pre-merge checks run first and their findings are verified by tool; NexCODE explains each one and adds what only judgement finds: no audit event on a refund, retries without an idempotency key, and a 2023 wiki tip the code follows that the standard has since overruled. The findings show as a table in the chat and as review comments on their lines in the IDE. Fix: the two Critical findings, the live key and the card number in the log, are fixed in the IDE, applied, and the tests run. File the review: the evidence record shows Changes requested, the tool output, the fixes and the AI disclosure, and the key goes for rotation under SCS-011.
